# Klipper (Moonraker) (`moonraker`)

A Klipper 3D printer through Moonraker's HTTP API: start the loaded job, pause, resume, emergency stop, and its state, temperatures and progress.

Generated from the manifest of `plugins/moonraker`. The plugin's own manuals: [README](../../../../plugins/moonraker/README.md) (what it supports, setup) and [DEVELOPING](../../../../plugins/moonraker/DEVELOPING.md) (protocol notes, sources).

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Version | 0.1.0 |
| Plugin API | 1 |
| Reaches | local network |
| Classes | `printer` |
| Config version | 1 |
| More than one instance | yes |
| Guided setup | yes |

## What it reaches

- HTTP to the device, port 7125

Nothing at all while the hub is in dry-run.

## Settings

| Key | Label | Kind | Required | Default | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | Moonraker address | URL (http, https) | yes |  | http:// and the printer's address with Moonraker's port, usually 7125, and nothing after it. |

## Secrets

| Slot | Label | Required | Help |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `api_key` | API key | no | Only when Moonraker asks for one. It is sent as a header and never in a URL. |

## Custom actions

None: it offers the standard actions of its classes.

## Words for voice

- Heard `clipper`, meant `klipper`
- `klipper` names the class `printer`
- `moonraker` names the class `printer`
